reports.title: Adverse Event Explorer Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz adverse event explorer with per-arm prevalence, between-arm differences, and participant drill-down. Reads the same Mapped_AE rows the Adverse Event Rate KRI counts.

reports.title: AE Timelines Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz adverse-event timelines, one row per participant, on the study days the events were recorded against.

reports.title: Hepatic Safety Explorer Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz eDISH hepatic safety explorer with Hy's Law quadrants and participant drill-down, over the study's own liver chemistry.

reports.title: QT Safety Explorer Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz QT/QTc safety explorer with central tendency against the ICH E14 threshold, outlier scatter, and categorical summaries. Change from baseline is the `egchg` the ECG mapping derived.

reports.title: Safety Delta-Delta Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz delta-delta plot of change from baseline in two laboratory measures, on the study's own visit schedule.

reports.title: Safety Histogram Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz histogram of the study's laboratory results, read from the same Mapped_LB domain the Grade 3+ Lab Abnormality KRI is computed from.

reports.title: Safety Outlier Explorer Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz outlier explorer over the study's laboratory results, with the reference range each result was graded against.

reports.title: Safety Results Over Time Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz results-over-time chart of the study's laboratory results across the scheduled visits.

reports.title: Safety Shift Plot Report
reports.description: Interactive safety.viz shift plot pairing each participant's baseline laboratory result with their Week 4 result.
